XHelpers Pro 1.0.16 (34)
- Resolution window: a new table-and-inspector layout, plus a per-display refresh rate ceiling that unlocks larger HiDPI presets on fast external displays and is reapplied after login, wake and reconnects. - Reclaim Disk Space and App Cleanup: large results are paged; your choices, focus and drafts survive refreshes; Undo and Resume offers stay current; Trash deletions report partial results and blockers clearly. - Duplicates review adds Quick Look for images and keeps keeper choices consistent when scanning again. - Updated translations in all 25 supported languages.
